items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Yeah, yeah, I know him, yeah.

ctx.x: Like Didi Pierce? Yeah, yeah. Did he? Yeah, yeah, I know him, yeah. He sings great. And Albert Burbank?
He was a trumpet player, Didi. And Albert Burbank? I can't think about the name of the song he mostly sang. Albert Burbank too. Yeah, he la va. Did you ever sing any of the songs?
